models.title: Linearly annualized partial-period inventory turnover
models.summary: The text scales quarterly inventory turnover by the ratio of the annual and quarterly lengths.

relationship.original_equation: Annualized inventory turnover = partial-period turnover × year length / partial-period length
relationship.translation_notes: Time lengths are same-unit numerical counts, not physical-duration unit conversions; the ratio of lengths is dimensionless.

assumptions: The observed turnover uses the same inventory and cost conventions throughout.
Year and observed period lengths use the same time unit; the public issuer example uses equal quarters.
limitations: Annualization assumes a constant observed run rate and is not the realized full-year turnover.
Seasonality, changing inventory balances and differing calendar lengths affect comparisons.
The owner example rounds its intermediate turnover before reporting approximate results.
